fact: Decreto-lei n.º 38/2024 of 29 July 2024 requires the entity managing the Justice Information System (SIJ) to adopt measures and processes leading to the system's certification to the ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 standards (article 20).
title: Boletim Oficial, I Série, n.º 71 (Decreto-lei nº 38/2024)
